name: Read the device's own record first
summary: Before cleaning up after an experiment, read what the device itself recorded: a boot entry's try counter, the bootloader's selection, the crash memory.
why: Three theories about the bootloader were wrong; the entry's counter settled it in one look.

name: A placed microphone gives relative levels
summary: A microphone placed by the phone tells which speaker is louder from where it stands, and whether there is sound at all - not absolute loudness.
why: Honest about what the instrument can say.

name: The phone is the reference
summary: Kept in a known-working state at all times: every experiment is one try that falls back by itself, and the phone is checked well before and after.
why: A reference that drifts cannot tell a regression from a mistake.
